When To Ask Programmer: If rule differs per character

Notes: ForwardSpeed is separate per jump category.

Notes: Defaults keep short hop honest.

Notes: CommandWindowFrames controls input leniency.

When To Ask Programmer: If character breaks shared air-action rules
Notes: Normal jump and super jump routes intentionally differ.

When To Ask Programmer: If rule differs per move/route
Notes: Higher leniency allows earlier double jump/airdash.

When To Ask Programmer: If collision behavior itself changes
Notes: These should follow the character body.

When To Ask Programmer: If side-resolution rules change
Notes: This is the simple Capcom/SNK-style position point/ECB stand-in.

Notes: Per-frame hurtboxes are a future tooling need.

Notes: Current system supports one hitbox per button.

When To Ask Programmer: If per-move timing table is needed
Notes: Current values are class-level: light/heavy/special.

When To Ask Programmer: If cinematic or per-hitstop exceptions are needed
Notes: Grounded and air hitstop are already separated.

When To Ask Programmer: If block pushback or corner-specific special rule is needed
Notes: Ground-to-air and air attack pushback have multipliers.

When To Ask Programmer: If corner rules change per character
Notes: Current corner pushback is global stage rule.

When To Ask Programmer: Never unless the needed condition is missing
Notes: Put specific rules before broad rules.

When To Ask Programmer: Never unless the needed target type is missing
Notes: Examples: LIGHT KICK, HEAVY PUNCH, SPECIAL 1. Filled exact targets override broad flags.

When To Ask Programmer: If the limit depends on a future system like meter or install state
Notes: 0 means unlimited.

When To Ask Programmer: If cancel depends on hitstop freeze or animation event tags
Notes: -1 means use legacy active-frame rule.

When To Ask Programmer: If the character needs a brand-new mechanic
Notes: Leave most chain flags off and only enable deliberate cancels.

When To Ask Programmer: If route needs new air movement behavior
Notes: Use an airborne ANY rule with air chain flags enabled.

When To Ask Programmer: If launcher needs custom physics beyond speed/hitstun/chase
Notes: Crouching HEAVY PUNCH currently demonstrates this.

When To Ask Programmer: When health/damage scaling system is added
Notes: Stored now; health system will consume it later.

When To Ask Programmer: When blocking system is added
Notes: Stored now; block system will consume it later.

When To Ask Programmer: If a new hit state is needed
Notes: Current move reactions are Normal Tumble Knockdown WallBounce GroundBounce Crumple; counter hit is automatic.

When To Ask Programmer: If a new recovery family is needed
Notes: Use Sweep AirKnockdown HardKnockdown SoftKnockdown WallBounce GroundBounce or Crumple.

When To Ask Programmer: When wakeup options are added
Notes: Knockdown is airborne falling state; GroundedKnockdown is lying down.

When To Ask Programmer: Never unless sweep needs a new reaction type
Notes: Set HitReaction to Knockdown, KnockdownType to Sweep, and tune KnockdownFrames Pushback and low hitbox.

When To Ask Programmer: If OTG needs unique scaling/rules
Notes: GroundedKnockdown is invincible by default; set this true only for deliberate OTG moves.

When To Ask Programmer: Ask programmer for new motion types
Notes: Current test command is QCF + Special 1 for Electric Wind God Fist.

When To Ask Programmer: If replacing with real particle/VFX scenes
Notes: Current prototype has normal yellow spark and heavy electric blue spark.

When To Ask Programmer: If gravity scaling becomes per-character later
